title: Free Human Theme Kit: take in the design system and load the theme into Frequency (website, Spotlight, Space page, email, starter kits)
detail: The Free Human Movement design system (code id free-human, editor theme FreeHuman) goes through docs/DESIGN-SYSTEM-INTAKE.md: rules, inventory, tokens, copy and a baseline of known gaps that only shrinks. The kit is then built the way Temple was: foundation and tokens, assets, chrome, eleven blocks, Home and Calendar pages, four emails, Spotlight layouts, thirteen starter kits and a /themes page on the Nocturne layout. Owner ruling 2026-10-29: load the theme only. No Free Human Movement Space or site data is created or seeded. Photo rights in design/photos/README.md are unresolved: the copyrighted ones must not ship in anything a Space receives until cleared. Built so far (2026-10-29): chrome, eleven blocks (Home, Calendar hero, Calendar, Year Wheel), the Home and Calendar pages, Spotlight preset and email surface from the flat token set, thirteen starter kits (free-human-<niche>, without the Books and Speaking sections that name one person), registration and live publishing. Shipped after the owner's call to build from the design system's own type, colours and ornaments (the handoff has no email or Spotlight screens): four themed emails (lib/theme/free-human-email.ts) and six Spotlight layouts (components/spotlight/free-human-layouts.tsx). The public /themes page was dropped by the owner. Open concerns: photo rights uncleared (32 photos); honey profile contrast 3.5:1; event kind is inferred from the title (no tag field); the Calendar closing band is not in the handoff's block list (optional closingTitle); Calendar defaultView is month where the handoff says list; the wheel covers 2026 to 2028 only (hand-entered eclipse and retrograde tables); the wheel thread is not responsive on phones, as in the design. Owner lifted the no-Space ruling 2026-10-29 (21:43Z): the Free Human Movement Space (slug freehumanmovement, owner danieltyack, Business comped, free-human theme) and its Space Spotlight are seeded by one guarded SQL transaction printed by scripts/render/free-human-space-sql.render.tsx (lib/sites/free-human-site.ts is the data): cover, logo, about, one program row carrying the four seasons, the design's 26 gatherings on the Space's own Circle, the Home and Calendar website and an eight-block Spotlight whose data blocks read the Space. The theme stays out of every picker. After Publish, scripts/attach-site-subdomain.mjs freehumanmovement attaches the address.

verify.evidence: Registered and private, thirteen starter kits, four themed emails and six Spotlight layouts ship, and the Space seed exists.
